platform: WordPress 6.5.9 · Total theme v5.19 · WPBakery Page Builder 6.13.0
_screenshot_note: Captured in the browser pane at 1280px. Operator reference ONLY — never design DNA. The generated site follows the owl template.
strengths: Real brand mark — the GreenTree oak logo is distinctive and the deep-green palette is coherent and ownable.
Honest, specific positioning: commercial-only, maintenance-only, since 1984, Minority Certified. Most competitors in this vertical say far less.
The GO GREENTREE acrostic is a genuine brand property, not filler.
Loads fast — there is almost nothing on it.
Viewport meta present; the Total theme is responsive out of the box.

weaknesses.issue: The homepage has no <h1> at all
weaknesses.detail: document.querySelectorAll('h1') returns zero elements on /. The page's only headings are two h2s. This is both a ranking defect and a screen-reader defect on the single most important page.

weaknesses.issue: No meta description on any page
weaknesses.detail: Confirmed null on / and /services/. Google is writing their search snippet for them.

weaknesses.issue: The phone number is not a link anywhere on the site
weaknesses.detail: Zero a[href^='tel:'] elements on / or /services/. On mobile the number cannot be tapped to call — for a business whose only conversion path is a phone call, this is the costliest single defect.
Zero JSON-LD blocks. No LocalBusiness, no Service, no FAQPage. Nothing for Google to build a knowledge panel from.
Contact page lists only 'Miami, FL USA'. Third-party directories disagree on the real address, which suggests the listings are unmanaged.

weaknesses.issue: Another company's website is live inside this one
weaknesses.detail: /193-2/ is titled ABOUT and serves complete marketing copy for Fluidity Funding Solutions — a Denver business lender — including its logo, its Denver address, its phone number, and an 'APPY NOW' typo. Unlinked from nav but publicly reachable and indexable. Left behind by whoever built the site.

weaknesses.issue: The four homepage service tiles do not link anywhere
weaknesses.detail: MAINTENANCE / PRUNING / IRRIGATION / PLANTING are presented as the core offering but there are no service pages behind them — everything collapses into one /services/ page.
Three counties are claimed in the header banner and nowhere else. No local landing surface at all.
Ten reviews under generic stock names with no company attribution, on a commercial-only contractor's site. Reads as agency filler. For a B2B buyer who will check, this actively damages trust.

Spruce, hostas and begonia borders — the hero is plainly a northern office park. A South Florida commercial landscaper showing no South Florida undercuts the local claim. Two assets are outright unusable: a blurry upscaled hedge and a 3D-rendered turf clipart.

weaknesses.issue: The hero carries no headline, no value proposition and no CTA
weaknesses.detail: The first viewport is a photograph with nothing on it. The 'Quality. Service. Dependability.' line and the welcome copy sit below the fold.

weaknesses.issue: Contact form has no visible spam protection and no confirmed destination
weaknesses.detail: Native WordPress form, one on the homepage and one on /contact-2/. No captcha detected.

weaknesses.issue: Duplicate and orphaned pages in the CMS
weaknesses.detail: /home/, /home-2/, /contact/ and /contact-2/ all exist. Nav points at /contact-2/ while /contact/ also resolves.

summary: A tidy but nearly empty four-page WordPress brochure with strong underlying positioning that the site does almost nothing with. Three defects are urgent regardless of whether a rebuild happens: the homepage has no h1, the phone number is not tappable, and a Denver lending company's marketing site is live at /193-2/. The material for a much stronger site already exists in the client's own copy — 42 years, commercial-only, maintenance-only, Minority Certified, and the GO GREENTREE acrostic — it is simply buried.
